revision_summary: Three minor timestamp drifts to correct: (1) rep_intent.evidence[2] quote about the specialist handoff is timestamped 09:07 but occurs at ~09:03-09:15 in transcript — retag to 09:07 is close enough but note the quote actually starts at 09:03; (2) trajectory_verdict.grounded_examples[1] and observed_outcome both cite '5 would be good?' at 09:51 attributed ambiguously — the customer says 'Five would be good' at [09:49-09:51] and the rep echoes 'Five would be good?' at [09:54]; Stage 3 should retag observed_outcome's quote to the customer's actual line at 09:51 and clarify speaker, or use the rep's confirming echo at 09:54 instead. Additionally: (a) fix schema misuse — intros.standard does not cover this call's named-referral opener (Tyson Jones referral), which is an undocumented third intro variant, not a form-fill intro; flag it as such rather than mapping to intros.standard; (b) rename script_coverage entry mislabeled 'tax_credit_qualifier' to 'credit_qualifier' since the quoted line is the 670 credit-score qualifier, not the tax-credit disclosure; (c) add missing script_coverage entry for residence_length (asked at 00:44, answered 'Since 2015'); (d) add the 00:11 'Is that really sales at all?' moment as a mild legitimacy-check/skepticism signal — this slightly undercuts the starting_state's claim of 'no hostility or skepticism voiced' and should be acknowledged even if quickly resolved; (e) reconsider the 'strategic' framing of rep_intent.evidence[1] (01:35 'most important question') given Stage 3's own later finding that the interest reason was never used/flipped — either soften to reactive/neutral or reconcile the contradiction. These are targeted, non-structural fixes; the core trajectory read (clean booked call, missing bill-flip and button-up completeness) is well-supported and should be preserved.
